currentCard.prompt: Какой орган накапливает и концентрирует желчь?

answers.note: Жёлчный пузырь хранит и концентрирует желчь между приёмами пищи.
Печень вырабатывает желчь и участвует в обмене питательных веществ.
Поджелудочная железа выделяет пищеварительный сок, а её островки вырабатывают инсулин.
Двенадцатиперстная кишка принимает желчь и сок поджелудочной железы.

currentCard.explanation: Жёлчный пузырь хранит и концентрирует желчь, произведённую печенью. После еды он выделяет её в тонкую кишку.

source.title: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology: The Gallbladder

literal.prompt: Какой орган накапливает и концентрирует желчь?

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: L31 andL79 explicitly assign bile storage and concentration to gallbladder;L82 provides concentration mechanism. Liver produces bile, pancreas produces digestive juice and duodenum receives secretions (L31,L45-L46,L65-L67). Each option is a real closely related digestive organ and therefore plausible; only gallbladder serves the ordinary storage/concentration role asked.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Жёлчный пузырь хранит и концентрирует желчь, произведённую печенью. После еды он выделяет её в тонкую кишку.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: First sentence correctly says gallbladder stores/concentrates liver-produced bile (L31,L58,L79). Second sentence describes after-meal release to small intestine, supported byL58 storage until next meal andL79,L81,L83 stimulated expulsion into duodenum; duodenum is the small-intestine target already identified atL31,L67. Exactly2 sentences, no change needed merely for style.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Жёлчный пузырь хранит и концентрирует желчь между приёмами пищи.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: L58 explicitly states that between meals bile is conserved and diverted to gallbladder, where concentrated/stored until next meal. This supports the temporal qualifier between meals, a concrete own-gallbladder cycle fact beyond prompt/key storage/concentration alone; it is not an unsupported filler. Overlap of storage wording does not erase the additional temporal information.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Печень вырабатывает желчь и участвует в обмене питательных веществ.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: L31,L45,L52 explicitly give liver bile production, whileL35,L39,L44-L48 describe nutrient metabolism/processing/storage. Note gives two true functions of the actual liver option without falsely making it the bile storage reservoir.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Поджелудочная железа выделяет пищеварительный сок, а её островки вырабатывают инсулин.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: L31,L64-L67,L70 describe pancreatic digestive juice secretion. L68 expressly names insulin among hormones produced by islets of Langerhans. Note correctly separates pancreatic juice and islet insulin; specific meaningful own-option fact, not generic wrong-answer label.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Двенадцатиперстная кишка принимает желчь и сок поджелудочной железы.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: L31 explicitly says liver bile and pancreatic juice delivered to duodenum;L45-L46 andL65-L67 trace their ducts and common/secondary openings. The note accurately identifies the receiving duodenal segment, rather than falsely assigning bile storage or manufacture to it.

absoluteLevel.ground: Distinguishing bile production in liver from storage/concentration in gallbladder requires familiarity with digestive physiology. All four options are meaningful organs in the same secretion route; an adult knowing only that bile relates to digestion may confuse the neighbouring roles. The specific concentration/storage distinction is thematic MEDIUM, not a rare professional detail or arbitrary HARD challenge.

correctNoteExtraFact.fact: Gallbladder stores/concentrates bile between meals until the next meal.
correctNoteExtraFact.beyondPromptKey: Between-meal timing is new relative to prompt plus gallbladder key and describes its physiological storage cycle. The repeated storage/concentration verbs do not substitute for this distinct temporal qualifier.
